title: Muxed address from the ID string "0x10" must be refused
why: MuxedAccount.med25519.id is a uint64; a builder that accepts a value no uint64 equals encodes some other ID, and the muxed address then routes to a different sub-account than the caller meant.

known_divergences.detail: Executed on 17.2.0 and 17.2.1: new MuxedAccount accepts the ID string "0x10" and encodes ID 16; 17.3.0 refuses the value (fix pull request #1780).
known_divergences.evidence: probe vector 2m5 (evidence/sdk-matrix), executed on js 17.2.0 and js 17.2.1; xcc conform run --columns 'js@*' --entries 'cap-0027/api-muxed-account-id-encoding.id-hex-string'

known_divergences.detail: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: new MuxedAccount accepts the ID string "0x10" and encodes ID 16. The 17.3.0 fix is not on the 16.x line.
known_divergences.evidence: probe vector 2m5 (evidence/sdk-matrix), executed on js 16.3.0 and js 16.3.1 and js 16.4.1; xcc conform run --columns 'js@*' --entries 'cap-0027/api-muxed-account-id-encoding.id-hex-string'
